responsibility: Implements the Alpha-specific GCC driver helper used for native CPU autodetection in command-line specs. Its host_detect_local_cpu routine probes the running processor with Alpha builtins such as implver and amask, maps the detected implementation/version and ISA-extension bits to GCC Alpha cpu names like ev4, ev5, ev56, pca56, ev6, or ev67, and returns the replacement -mcpu=native or -mtune=native option string that the driver injects during spec processing.
